description:
All-in-one solution for IT professionals

DiskGenius provides an all-in-one solution for data recovery, disk partition management and backup & restore for Windows PCs, Servers and workstations.
- New
  1. Added support for migrating the current system to a VHD virtual disk and booting from VHD.
  2. Added support for deploying Windows installation images directly to VHD.
  3. Added a "TRIM Optimization" mode to the Erase Sectors feature.
  4. Added a "GB 46864-2025" standard mode to the Erase Sectors feature.
  5. Added support for adjusting partitions to meet the requirements for MBR/GUID partition table conversion when standard conversion conditions are not met.
  6. DiskGenius now performs boot-mode conversion together with partition table style conversion to ensure the converted system remains bootable.
  7. Added support for converting a single disk containing only simple volumes in a dynamic disk group to a basic disk.
  8. Added hardware-accelerated decoding support for video preview.
  9. Added preview support for OSV, M2P, LRF, and LRV video files and JXR image files.
  10. Added thumbnail preview support for video and PDF files.
- Enhanced
  1. After file copying is completed, the number of copied folders is now displayed, and the folder count has been added to the report.
  2. Improved support for EXT4 file systems with orphan_file and ea_inode attributes.
  3. Optimized and improved the disk speed test feature.
  4. Optimized the Verify Or Repair Bad Sectors/Blocks feature.
  5. Optimized the default number of partitions and the default system partition size in Quick Partition.
  6. Optimized recovery by file type and added support for JXL and JP2 file types.
  7. Improved the recovery of MP4 videos captured by certain devices.
  8. When cloning disks or partitions sector by sector, or restoring them from image files, DiskGenius now skips writing all-zero data if the target disk supports TRIM, helping reduce disk wear.
  9. The Lite Edition now supports copying files to ESP partitions.
  10. Added a "System" menu to the main menu.
- Fixed
  1. Fixed issues where the second PMF image could not be loaded and PMF images could be loaded repeatedly.
  2. Fixed an issue in Quick Partition where no partition was created when the disk capacity was greater than 2 TB, only one partition was selected, and the existing ESP partition was not retained.
  3. Fixed the issue where the starting position of the system partition on an MBR disk could not be adjusted.
  4. Fixed an issue in file-based backup of NTFS partitions where the displayed progress data amount did not match the actual backed-up data amount.
  5. Fixed an issue where the system might report an error after formatting an NTFS partition.
  6. Fixed abnormal progress display when cloning EXT4 partitions in some cases.
  7. Fixed symlink errors that occurred in some cases when restoring EXT4 partitions from image files.
  8. Fixed an issue where EXT4 partition PMF images could not be loaded in some cases.
  9. Fixed an issue in the Lite Edition where files could not be selected by mouse click in the file selection dialog.
  10. Other bug fixes.
